decisions.reason: The location-based margin analysis builds directly on the firm's maintained market-data databases and tariff know-how, still has its own page in 2024, and fits the platform strategy, so the firm can interpret its results and improve it with its own R&D.

The regional electricity tariff calculator sits close to the core tariff-calculation competence and is cheap to maintain on existing data, although its drop from a dedicated page to a mention and the removal of the related gas and energy calculators suggest it may be consolidated into the platform.

The regional area definition tool draws on the firm's network and location data expertise and likely serves as a building block for its other location-based applications, so keeping it within the central platform makes sense despite its reduced web prominence.
